channels.title: Channels
channels.sub: Talk to your agents from Telegram or Discord. Each channel is off until you turn it on; only chats you pair here are answered.
channels.token_hint_before: No bot token yet. Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token in
channels.pick_other_before: A chat can still pick someone else with
channels.pair_hint: Create a code, then send it to your bot from a private chat or a group. It works once and only for 10 minutes. In a group the bot answers only commands and messages that mention it, and only from the people on that group's list (whoever sends the code is put on it).
channels.paired_hint: Results of finished runs go to each private chat, and privately (DM) to each person on a group's list. A member the bot cannot message is marked unreachable — ask them to send /start to the bot.
channels.can_talk: Can talk to the agents here (results come to them privately):
channels.nobody_can_talk: Nobody can talk to the agents here yet. Add people below.
channels.unreachable: unreachable — ask them to send /start to the bot
channels.wrote_not_list: Wrote to the bot here but are not on the list (told once):
channels.off_discord: Off. Nothing is sent to or read from Discord.
channels.off_telegram: Off. Nothing is sent to or read from Telegram.
channels.discord_unreachable: unreachable — ask them to open a DM with the bot
channels.discord_webhook_note: The Boardroom Discord webhook (if you use one) is separate and unchanged.
channels.discord_token_hint_before: No bot token yet. Create a bot in the Discord Developer Portal, enable the Message Content Intent, and paste the token in
channels.discord_pair_hint: Create a code, then send it to your bot from a DM or a server text channel. It works once and only for 10 minutes. In a server channel the bot answers only commands and messages that mention it, and only from the people on that channel's list (whoever sends the code is put on it).
channels.discord_paired_hint: Results of finished runs go to each paired DM, and privately to each person on a server channel's list. A member the bot cannot message is marked unreachable — ask them to open a DM with the bot.
